stories.title: Police warn against swimming and off road biking at Flintshire Quarry
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people to stay away from Pant Quarry in Halkyn, after a high number of calls about off road bikes and swimmers at the site. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of fake bank call and WhatsApp scam
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people not to share bank details after a scam involving fake fraud calls followed by WhatsApp messages. stories.title: North Wales force’s handling of rural crime and emergency calls examined by PCC
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s handling of rural crime and how quickly officers respond to emergency calls faced scrutiny at the force’s latest Strategic Executive Board meeting. stories.title: 37% of Wales coastguards may cut hours over pay changes, GMB survey finds

stories.title: Garden waste collections delayed to evening across Flintshire today
stories.summary: Flintshire households due a brown bin collection today will have their garden waste collected this evening instead of during the day.
